hero.title: A single read model for the latest draw, live signals, and prediction summary
hero.description: This dashboard mock keeps the latest draw, hot/cold/overdue signals, and prediction summary in one checked shape so the API can replace the fixture without spreading contract logic across the page.

metrics.label: Draws in sample
metrics.hint: Mock draw count currently used to exercise the dashboard contract.

metrics.label: Hot number
metrics.hint: Two-digit number with the strongest recent frequency in this mock sample.

metrics.label: Cold number
metrics.hint: Number currently appearing below the sample baseline in the same window.

metrics.label: Overdue number
metrics.hint: Number missing longer than the rest of the current mock sample.

signals.label: Hot signal
signals.reason: Repeated more often than the sample average across recent two-digit prize rows.

signals.label: Overdue signal
signals.reason: Missing longer than the normal gap observed in the current mock sample.

signals.label: Cold signal
signals.reason: Appears less often than neighboring numbers in the same evaluation window.

predictionSummary.title: Prediction summary mock
predictionSummary.disclaimer: These outputs summarize historical signals from mock data. They do not guarantee future draw outcomes.

contractRows.purpose: Shows the newest verified draw and the main prize groups surfaced on the dashboard.
Summarizes draw count and the first signal cards users should notice immediately.
Shares the same signal vocabulary used by Analytics, Compare, and Prediction Lab.
Surfaces candidate numbers, scores, and reasons without embedding scoring logic in the page.
